title: run/start
description: Starts the one run this runner process serves. It carries everything the runner may use.

direction.description: What the actor is asked to do in this run: its direction.

character.description: Who the actor is: its character, its standing prompt, kept apart from the direction. Absent: the actor has none.

workspace.description: The absolute path of the directory the actor works in.

effects.description: The actor's declared effects, all three lists always present: empty lists mean read-only. The runner applies them its own way, and says how in its init event.

scratch.description: The absolute path of an empty directory, outside the workspace, that the runner and its engine may use for anything during the run without any effect. troupe removes it when the run ends.

options.description: Runner-specific options. troupe passes them through unchanged. An extension point: the runner's published options schema fills it, and without one only {} validates.

eventMaxBytes.description: The largest serialised run event troupe keeps inline. Summarise below it.

onContextFull.description: What the run does when its engine's context fills, as troupe resolved it from the actor and policy. fail: the run ends with reason context-length, and the runner neither compacts nor lets its engine compact. compact: the runner, or its engine, may compact or drop earlier content and carry on, and reports each time with a context event.

runtime.description: The service this run talks to, as troupe resolved it from its defaults, the theatre's config and the person's environment. Absent: the actor names no runtime. The credential's value is never here: when credential is true, it is in the runner's environment as TROUPE_RUNTIME_CREDENTIAL, and the runner sends it only to the endpoint.

runnerOptions.title: The runner's options
runnerOptions.description: The default for the runnerOptions extension point: no options.

endpoint.description: The base URL the runner's API is served under. The runner adds its own paths. Absent for an in-process runtime, which has no endpoint: its runner loads the model in its own process.

model.description: The model the run uses, as the service names it, or, for an in-process runtime, as its runner reads it (for mistralrs, the absolute path of a GGUF file).

credential.description: true: the runner's environment holds the credential as TROUPE_RUNTIME_CREDENTIAL. false: the runtime has none, and the variable isn't set.

price.description: The price troupe has for the run's model, from the runtime's prices in config. Absent: nothing prices the model, and the runner sends no estimate.
